title: A cytoplasmic cis-acting circuit confines PI3K/AKT-driven lineage plasticity in bladder cancer.
authors: Dong, Xuan; Li, Yutong; Yan, Yongtai; Xiong, Hong; Wu, Pulin; Chen, Yongjie; Yi, Zhaofeng; Zhou, Cong; Zuo, Ling; Liu, Hongwei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究膀胱癌中circNFAT5/miR-552-3p/FoxO1轴调控肿瘤进展，虽涉及FoxO1转录因子与UBC启动子结合（ChIP-seq和计算对接），但核心是ceRNA调控和肿瘤生物学，非TF-DNA互作机制建模，AI/物理模拟方法仅浅层提及，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Bladder cancer (BCa) is a prevalent urological malignancy characterized by high recurrence rates and limited therapeutic options for advanced disease. Circular RNAs (circRNAs) have emerged as critical regulators of gene expression in cancer, yet their roles in BCa progression remain incompletely understood. Here, circ_0006845 (circNFAT5) is identified as a tumor-suppressive circRNA that is significantly downregulated in BCa tissues and cell lines. Functional assays demonstrate that circNFAT5 inhibits BCa cell proliferation, migration, and invasion in vitro and suppresses subcutaneous tumor growth in vivo. Mechanistically, circNFAT5 localizes predominantly to the cytoplasm and functions as a competing endogenous RNA (ceRNA) by competitively sponging miR-552-3p, thereby relieving post-transcriptional repression of the Forkhead box O1 (FoxO1) transcription factor. Single-cell RNA sequencing analysis further identifies Ubiquitin C (UBC) as a potential downstream target of FoxO1, with FoxO1 occupancy at the UBC promoter supported by ChIP-seq and computational docking predicting a potential interaction. Intercellular communication profiling identifies ANNEXIN, COMPLEMENT, SEMA3, VEGF, and VISFATIN as dominant PI3K/AKT-associated axis mediating cross-talk between FoxO1-low tumor subpopulations and stromal cells within the tumor microenvironment. Drug sensitivity analysis predicts that FoxO1-low BCa cells may exhibit enhanced sensitivity to cisplatin, gemcitabine, and PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway inhibitors. These findings delineate a circNFAT5/miR-552-3p/FoxO1/UBC regulatory axis associated with PI3K/AKT signaling that may contribute to BCa progression, nominating FoxO1 as a candidate prognostic biomarker and a potential therapeutic stratification marker.
abstract_zh: 膀胱癌（BCa）是一种常见的泌尿系统恶性肿瘤，以高复发率和晚期疾病治疗选择有限为特征。环状RNA（circRNAs）已成为癌症中基因表达的关键调控因子，但其在BCa进展中的作用仍未被完全理解。本文中，circ_0006845（circNFAT5）被鉴定为一种肿瘤抑制性circRNA，在BCa组织和细胞系中显著下调。功能实验表明，circNFAT5在体外抑制BCa细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭，并在体内抑制皮下肿瘤生长。机制上，circNFAT5主要定位于细胞质，并通过竞争性海绵吸附miR-552-3p作为竞争性内源RNA（ceRNA）发挥作用，从而解除对Forkhead box O1（FoxO1）转录因子的转录后抑制。单细胞RNA测序分析进一步将Ubiquitin C（UBC）鉴定为FoxO1的潜在下游靶点，ChIP-seq支持FoxO1在UBC启动子上的占据，计算对接预测了潜在相互作用。细胞间通讯分析识别出ANNEXIN、COMPLEMENT、SEMA3、VEGF和VISFATIN作为主导的PI3K/AKT相关轴，介导肿瘤微环境中FoxO1低表达肿瘤亚群与基质细胞之间的串扰。药物敏感性分析预测，FoxO1低表达BCa细胞可能对顺铂、吉西他滨和PI3K/AKT/mTOR通路抑制剂表现出增强的敏感性。这些发现描绘了一个与PI3K/AKT信号相关的circNFAT5/miR-552-3p/FoxO1/UBC调控轴，可能促进BCa进展，并将FoxO1提名为候选预后生物标志物和潜在的治疗分层标志物。
